patreon_access_token.hint: Register an API v2 client at https://www.patreon.com/portal/registration/register-clients (a creator account is required), then copy the Creator's Access Token from the client page.

scan_interval_minutes.hint: How often the plugin polls Patreon for new posts (default: 30).

notify_on_first_scan.description: Notify about posts found on the very first scan
notify_on_first_scan.hint: When false, the first scan only records the current latest posts without sending notifications.

max_posts_per_check.description: Maximum new posts to notify per creator per scan

creators.hint: Add one template entry per creator. campaign_id is mandatory; display_name is used in notification templates.

campaign_id.hint: Numeric ID from the creator page URL. Use /patreon campaigns to list IDs your token can access.

telegram_bot_token.hint: Create a bot with @BotFather and paste its token here.

telegram_chat_ids.hint: One ID per line, e.g. -1001234567890. Find an ID with @userinfobot or the bot API getUpdates endpoint.

telegram_parse_mode.hint: HTML, Markdown, MarkdownV2, or empty for plain text. When set, escape reserved characters in your template.
